builds.hypothesis: Q5 is1.2AD+1AP+10% target maxHP MAGIC. AP/MR modifiers exploit1AP; compare AD swap because1.2AD also strong. Deathcap multiplies AP; Zhonya adds105AP; Riftmaker adds bonusHP-to-AP and8% full-ramp damage. Void/Shadowflame penetrate MR and amplify eligible low-health hits. Nearby Abyssal makes target take12% more magic damage. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

kitEvidence.formula:
Tap: Warwick lunges forward and bites, dealing [(1.2) × AD + (1) × AP] plus [6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10]% max Health magic damage and healing for [25 / 37.5 / 50 / 62.5 / 75]% of the damage dealt.

Hold: Warwick lunges and clamps his jaws on the target, leaping behind them. While clamped, Warwick follows all movement of the target. After releasing his hold, he does the same damage and healing.

builds.summary: Investigate a high Infinite Duress core channel damage result under finite conditions, with a practical control and one-slot swaps. Candidate, not proof of a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate a high Infinite Duress core channel damage result under finite conditions, with a practical control and one-slot swaps. Candidate, not proof of a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-3 R's listed total channel damage is 525 + 1.67 bonus AD magic over 1.5 seconds. Bloodthirster, finite Hubris and Sterak feed bonus AD, but MR penetration and nearby Abyssal affect delivery. The tooltip total is not repeated three times merely because the channel applies three attacks/on-hits.

builds.name: Eternal Hunger: below-25% self-heal
builds.summary: Explore high one empowered Eternal Hunger self-heal output under a finite benchmark; compare alternatives without claiming a solver-certified maximum.
builds.goal: Explore high one empowered Eternal Hunger self-heal output under a finite benchmark; compare alternatives without claiming a solver-certified maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Passive on-hit magic damage is a level-scaled 6 to 55 + 0.15 bonus AD + 0.10 AP. Below 50% owner HP it heals for 100% of damage dealt; below 25% it heals for 250%. Target MR and penetration can therefore change the heal, unlike a purely AP-based heal formula.
